description: Iron balance model: can traditional beer iron intake deliver the hepatic iron load required to cross the 400 umol/g fibrosis threshold within the observed 2-4 decade onset window?
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Hypothesis: traditional-beer iron intake alone, at physiological
# absorption efficiencies, delivers enough iron to cross the hepatic
# fibrosis threshold within the observed onset window (4th-6th decade).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

FE_BEER   = 46.0     # mg Fe / L traditional beer (measured; range 15-80)
LOSS      = 1.0      # mg/day obligate loss, adult male
LIVER_WET = 1500.0   # g
DRY_FRAC  = 0.30     # dry/wet weight ratio of liver
HIC_FIB   = 400.0    # umol Fe / g dry wt = fibrosis threshold (PMID 3943787)
FE_MW     = 55.845   # g/mol

liver_dry   = LIVER_WET * DRY_FRAC                  # g dry weight
hep_thresh  = HIC_FIB * 1e-6 * FE_MW * liver_dry * 1000  # mg Fe in liver at threshold
# fraction of total body iron excess deposited in liver.
# African iron overload loads macrophages AND hepatocytes, so the hepatic
# share is lower than in HFE disease (~0.5-0.6). Model 0.25-0.45.
print(f"Liver dry weight            : {liver_dry:.0f} g")
print(f"Hepatic Fe at 400 umol/g    : {hep_thresh/1000:.2f} g")

vols = np.linspace(0.5, 8.0, 160)        # L beer / day
absf = np.array([0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20])   # fractional absorption

def years_to_threshold(vol, a, liver_share=0.35):
    intake  = FE_BEER * vol                 # mg/day ingested
    net     = intake * a - LOSS             # mg/day retained
    if net <= 0: return np.nan
    return hep_thresh / (net * liver_share) / 365.25

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(16.5, 5.0))

# --- panel A: years to fibrosis threshold -----------------------
ax = axes[0]
for a in absf:
    y = np.array([years_to_threshold(v, a) for v in vols])
    ax.plot(vols, y, lw=2.2, label=f"{a*100:.0f}% absorbed")
ax.axhspan(20, 40, color="0.85", zorder=0)
ax.text(7.8, 30, "observed window\n(20-40 y of drinking,\nonset 4th-6th decade)",
        ha="right", va="center", fontsize=8.5, color="0.25")
ax.set_ylim(0, 90); ax.set_xlim(0.5, 8)
ax.set_xlabel("Traditional beer consumed (L / day)")
ax.set_ylabel("Years to reach hepatic Fe of 400 umol/g dry wt")
ax.set_title("A. Time to cross the fibrosis threshold\n(46 mg Fe/L, 35% of retained Fe to liver)", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8, title="Fractional Fe\nabsorption", title_fontsize=8)
ax.grid(alpha=.3)

# --- panel B: sensitivity to hepatic share ----------------------
ax = axes[1]
shares = np.linspace(0.15, 0.60, 120)
for v, c in zip([1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 6.0], plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(.1,.85,4))):
    y = [years_to_threshold(v, 0.10, s) for s in shares]
    ax.plot(shares*100, y, lw=2.2, color=c, label=f"{v:.0f} L/day")
ax.axhspan(20, 40, color="0.85", zorder=0)
ax.set_ylim(0, 90)
ax.set_xlabel("Share of retained iron deposited in liver (%)")
ax.set_ylabel("Years to threshold")
ax.set_title("B. Sensitivity to hepatic iron share\n(absorption fixed at 10%)", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=.3)

# --- panel C: minimum absorption needed -------------------------
ax = axes[2]
targets = [20, 30, 40]
for t, c in zip(targets, ["#c0392b", "#e67e22", "#2980b9"]):
    # solve a such that years == t  ->  net = hep_thresh/(t*365.25*share)
    share = 0.35
    need_net = hep_thresh / (t*365.25*share)          # mg/day retained
    a_need   = (need_net + LOSS) / (FE_BEER*vols)
    ax.plot(vols, a_need*100, lw=2.2, color=c, label=f"threshold in {t} y")
ax.axhspan(5, 20, color="#d5f5e3", zorder=0)
ax.text(7.8, 12.5, "physiological range for\nnon-heme Fe absorption\nin iron-replete to\niron-avid adults",
        ha="right", va="center", fontsize=8.5, color="#145a32")
ax.set_ylim(0, 45); ax.set_xlim(0.5, 8)
ax.set_xlabel("Traditional beer consumed (L / day)")
ax.set_ylabel("Fractional Fe absorption required (%)")
ax.set_title("C. Absorption efficiency required\nto reach threshold in a given time", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=.3)

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("\n--- Years to fibrosis threshold (hepatic share 35%) ---")
print(f"{'L/day':>6} " + "".join(f"{a*100:>8.0f}%" for a in absf))
for v in [1,2,3,4,6,8]:
    row = "".join(f"{years_to_threshold(v,a):>9.1f}" for a in absf)
    print(f"{v:>6} {row}")

# daily net retention at a representative exposure
for v,a in [(1,0.10),(2,0.10),(4,0.10),(4,0.05),(2,0.20)]:
    net = FE_BEER*v*a - LOSS
    print(f"\n{v} L/day at {a*100:.0f}% absorption -> intake {FE_BEER*v:.0f} mg/d, "
          f"net retention {net:.1f} mg/d = {net*365.25/1000:.2f} g/y")
